title: Senior Sales Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p class="p1">With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.</p> <p class="p1">Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.</p> <p class="p1">At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.</p> <p class="p1">Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.</p></div><h3>Reports To</h3> <p>VP Sales - Europe</p> <h3>What You Will Be Doing</h3> <p>• Own the full sales cycle for a portfolio of enterprise accounts — from first conversation through to close — and grow revenue across both existing relationships and new business within CPOs, retail, hospitality, amusement & recreation, and telecoms.<br>• Build and execute a territory plan for the UK that identifies the highest-value opportunities across charge point operators and destination verticals, leverages ChargePoint’s channel partners and resellers, and sequences deals with discipline.<br>• Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder organisations: you will engage operations directors, property managers, sustainability leads, procurement teams and C-suite decision-makers, often within the same deal.<br>• Develop consultative, solution-led proposals that combine ChargePoint’s hardware, software and energy management capabilities into outcomes your customers care about — whether that is network uptime for a CPO, dwell-time revenue for a hospitality brand, or footfall conversion for a retailer.<br>• Maintain a clean, accurate pipeline in Salesforce and deliver reliable forecasts — your leadership team will rely on your judgement.<br>• Collaborate closely with our Solutions Engineering, Marketing and Customer Success teams to deliver a seamless experience from pre-sale through deployment.<br>• Stay close to the evolving UK charging landscape: understand CPO business models, OZEV grant programmes, the UK’s ZEV mandate trajectory, and how destination charging is becoming a competitive differentiator for retail, leisure and hospitality brands.</p> <h3>What You Will Bring to ChargePoint</h3> <div id="message-list_1789547694.266459"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <ul> <li><strong>Enterprise sales credibility in complex environments</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>— you bring at least five years of closing experience selling technical or SaaS solutions to large organisations, with a track record of personally originating, shaping and closing multi-stakeholder deals across operations, sustainability, procurement and C-suite contacts.</li> <li><strong>Territory-building discipline</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>— you know how to build a market from a plan, not just work one you inherited. You can identify high-value targets across CPOs, retail, hospitality, amusement & recreation and telecoms, sequence deals with rigour, and balance your own prospecting with channel partner leverage and inbound pipeline.</li> <li><strong>Consultative, outcome-led selling</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>— you move beyond product features to build proposals around what the customer actually cares about — network uptime for a CPO, dwell-time revenue for a hospitality brand, footfall conversion for a retailer — combining ChargePoint's hardware, software and energy management capabilities into a single, compelling business case.</li> <li><strong>Fluency in the UK charging landscape</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>— you either understand CPO business models, destination charging economics, OZEV grant programmes, grid connection challenges and the ZEV mandate trajectory, or you can demonstrate you will get up to speed quickly enough to hold credible conversations from day one.</li> <li><strong>Forecast reliability and pipeline discipline</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span>— you maintain a clean, accurate Salesforce pipeline that your leadership team can trust, and you take personal accountability for the quality of your forecast — no sandbagging, no inflating, just honest commercial judgement.</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <p>• You bring at least five years of enterprise sales experience, ideally selling technical or SaaS solutions to large organisations. E-mobility or energy infrastructure experience is a strong plus, but not essential if you bring the right commercial instincts and an understanding of how CPOs, retailers, or hospitality operators buy.<br>• You have a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding quota, and you can point to complex deals you personally originated, shaped and closed.<br>• You are comfortable building a territory from a plan — identifying targets, working with channel partners and managing your own prospecting alongside inbound pipeline.<br>• You understand the UK charging ecosystem or can demonstrate you will get up to speed quickly: CPO business models, destination charging economics, grid connection challenges, and how public and workplace charging strategies intersect.<br>• You communicate with clarity and credibility, whether presenting to a C-suite audience, writing a business case, or briefing internal stakeholders.<br>• You are based in the United Kingdom and willing to travel regularly across the territory.</p> <h3><strong>Location</strong></h3> <p>UK- Remote</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. title: Head of Talent Acquisition, International
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong></p> <p>As the Head of Talent Acquisition, EMEA, you own the build-out of Anduril's talent acquisition capability across<br>the EMEA region. Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Acquisition and partnering closely with the Head of<br>Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition, you are a key member of the TA Leadership team with a specific<br>mandate: geo-specific scaling. You own the in-country, site-specific, and division-specific hiring build-out across<br>EMEA, working in close partnership with the Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC and with each Divisional Head of<br>TA who is adding headcount into your region.</p> <p>This is not a divisional leadership seat. You are not embedded in any single business unit's leadership team; you<br>are the connective tissue across all of them for one geography. Multiple divisions will be scaling into EMEA at<br>once, often into the same countries and talent pools, and your job is to make sure their combined demand lands<br>on a coherent, compliant, and well-resourced regional hiring capability, rather than five uncoordinated efforts<br>competing for the same candidates.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <p><strong>Regional Strategy and Build-Out</strong><br>• Define and execute Anduril's EMEA talent acquisition strategy, directly informed by the combined hiring<br>demand of every division scaling into the region.<br>• Own EMEA hiring outcomes (time-to-fill, quality, acceptance rates) as the single accountable owner for<br>regional delivery.<br>• Own EMEA hiring governance, compliance, and workforce planning across the region's countries, each with<br>distinct labor law, works council, and candidate market dynamics.<br>• Develop EMEA hiring playbooks, and partner with the Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC to share what's<br>working across both regions rather than each building in isolation.<br>• Partner with the Head of Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition to evaluate where EMEA needs additional<br>in-country or sub-regional leadership as demand grows (e.g., a dedicated UK or Germany lead), and help<br>build the case and the structure for it.<br><br><strong>Cross-Divisional Partnership and Prioritization</strong><br><strong>• </strong>Serve as the senior talent advisor to EMEA-based business leaders and to every Divisional Head of TA adding<br>headcount into the region, synthesizing what could otherwise be five disconnected divisional views into one<br>coherent regional talent picture.<br>• Partner with in-region recruiting resources and EMEA business leaders to ensure the regional model reflects<br>on-the-ground reality, not just headquarters assumptions.<br>• Act as the tie-breaker when multiple divisions' hiring demand converges on the same country, site, or talent<br>pool with more need than the region can serve at once, using an objective, business-impact-driven<br>framework.<br>• Drive continuous improvement through data and feedback loops, standardizing what should be consistent<br>across EMEA while preserving the flexibility each country and division genuinely needs.</p> <p><strong>Operational Cohesion with Peer Regions</strong><br><strong>•</strong> Partner closely with the Head of Strategic Planning for Talent Acquisition, a peer, not a manager, who is<br>accountable for cross-regional cohesion, shared playbooks, and consistency of operating rhythm across<br>EMEA and APAC.<br>• Loop in the Head of Strategic Planning early on build-out choices (tooling, process, governance) so that<br>EMEA and APAC remain coherent for divisions scaling into both regions.<br>• Resolve cross-regional alignment issues collaboratively, escalating to the Senior Director of Talent<br>Acquisition only when peer alignment can't be reached.</p> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong><br><strong>•</strong> 10+ years of progressive TA experience, including demonstrated success building or scaling EMEA hiring<br>specifically, not just supporting it from a distance.<br>• Deep understanding of EMEA labor markets, employment law, works councils, and compliance<br>considerations across the region's key countries.<br>• Proven experience designing and executing an end-to-end regional talent acquisition strategy.<br>• Demonstrated ability to lead and influence across a matrixed structure, partnering with multiple Divisional<br>Heads of TA and business leaders who do not report to you.<br>• Strong track record of driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision making, with the ability<br>to report regional hiring outcomes credibly to Global TA Leadership.<br>• Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to reconcile competing divisional demand<br>for the same regional capacity and drive consensus without formal authority.</p> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <p>perience partnering with or building out in-country resources as part of a broader regional build.</p> <p class="p1">• Experience building a regional operating model that other regions (e.g., APAC) have adapted or could adapt.</p> <p class="p1">• Prior experience as part of a broader transition from a U.S.-led to a localized, globally scalable TA model.</p> <p class="p1">• Experience in defense, aerospace, or other hardware and software-intensive industries.</p> <p class="p1">• A background in or strong familiarity with BizOps, program management, or business strategy.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span data-contrast="auto">The salary range title: Senior Manager, Products & Services - Consumer Products & Retail
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Consumer Products & Retail Transformation practice are looking for a Senior Manager/Director to join the team</span></span></h2> <p>Our Consumer Products & Retail practice is looking for an experienced Senior Manager or Director to join the team and help our clients deliver complex, business-critical transformation.</p> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated consulting leader with a strong track record of designing and delivering large-scale transformation programmes within the consumer products and retail sectors. This could include experience across supply chain transformation, S&OP, planning and forecasting, ERP-enabled transformation, or operating model design and implementation.</p> <p>This is a broad transformation leadership role rather than a position focused on a single functional specialism. The right person will combine strong consulting and programme leadership capabilities with the commercial confidence to lead client relationships, manage complex engagements, and identify opportunities to deepen and grow existing accounts.</p> <p>Candidates may have built their career entirely within consulting or combined consulting with relevant industry experience. However, substantial consulting experience and a clear understanding of how to lead clients through complex transformation are essential.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">What we are looking for</span></h3> <p>You will be a pragmatic transformation leader who is comfortable moving between strategic thinking and the realities of implementation. You will understand what it takes to mobilise and deliver complex programmes, engage senior client stakeholders, and create alignment across business and technology teams.</p> <p>You do not need to be a pure business development or new-logo origination specialist. However, you must be comfortable owning senior client relationships, leading the day-to-day development of accounts, and identifying opportunities to broaden our impact with existing clients.</p> <p>You will also bring enough depth in consumer products or retail to understand the commercial and operational context in which clients are transforming, while retaining the breadth to work across different types of transformation challenge.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Lead complex transformation engagements for consumer products and retail clients, taking responsibility for successful delivery from initial design through to implementation.</li> <li>Help clients shape and deliver transformation across areas such as supply chain, S&OP, business planning, forecasting, ERP implementation, and operating model effectiveness.</li> <li>Translate strategic objectives into practical transformation roadmaps, delivery plans, governance structures, and measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Lead the day-to-day management of major client accounts and engagements, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.</li> <li>Act as a confident and credible account leader who can strengthen client relationships, identify emerging needs, and grow existing accounts.</li> <li>Oversee complex programmes involving multiple workstreams, business functions, technology platforms, geographies, and stakeholder groups.</li> <li>Work across business and technology teams to ensure that transformation programmes deliver sustainable operational improvements rather than standalone systems or process changes.</li> <li>Advise clients on the organisational, process, capability, data, and technology changes required to deliver successful transformation.</li> <li>Provide clear leadership to multidisciplinary project teams, creating an environment in which consultants can perform effectively and develop their capabilities.</li> <li>Manage programme risks, dependencies, budgets, resources, governance, and senior stakeholder expectations.</li> <li>Support business development activity through proposal development, solution design, client presentations, and the expansion of existing relationships.</li> <li>Contribute to the continued development of our Consumer Products & Retail practice, including its propositions, delivery capabilities, market profile, and people.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>Significant experience within consulting, with a strong track record of leading complex transformation engagements for consumer products or retail clients.</li> <li>Experience operating at Senior Manager, Director, or an equivalent level within a recognised consulting organisation.</li> <li>Demonstrable expertise in one or more of the following areas:</li> <ul> <li>Supply chain transformation</li> <li>Sales and operations planning, or S&OP</li> <li>Demand, supply, or integrated business planning</li> <li>Forecasting and planning transformation</li> <li>ERP-enabled business transformation</li> <li>Operating model design and implementation</li> <li>Complex programme leadership</li> </ul> <li>Experience leading major transformation programmes from strategy and design through to implementation and business adoption.</li> <li>A strong understanding of how business processes, operating models, data, technology, organisation design, and change management come together within a successful transformation.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary consulting teams and manage multiple workstreams within complex client environments.</li> <li>Strong client engagement and account management skills, with the confidence to work with senior client stakeholders and manage important day-to-day relationships.</li> <li>Evidence of growing or expanding existing client accounts by identifying additional client needs and converting them into relevant opportunities.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing engagement economics, delivery quality, scope, risk, and client expectations.</li> <li>The ability to communicate complex transformation topics clearly and credibly to both business and technology stakeholders.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving, facilitation, influencing, and stakeholder management capabilities.</li> <li>A collaborative leadership style and a strong commitment to coaching and developing consulting talent.</li> <li>Industry experience gained before, during, or after a consulting career would be valuable, but candidates must bring substantial and current consulting capability.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h3><br><span title: Senior/Staff Evaluation Data Analyst (Agentic Search)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.</p></div><ul class="d9579f95 _005fca58"> <li> <p>In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.<br>We’re looking for an experienced Data Analyst who has built evaluation systems for complex technology products and is excited to take end-to-end ownership of quality in search built for AI agents.<br>This role combines hands-on engineering, analytical judgment, and mathematical rigor, with the scope and influence to shape both technical decisions and product direction. We move at a startup pace, with plenty of open questions and difficult problems to solve.</p> <p><strong><u>In this position, you will:</u></strong></p> <p>• Own the quality measurement and improvement cycle end-to-end: identify user needs, define success, build evaluations, diagnose failures, and work with engineers and product managers to improve outcomes..<br>• Design, build, and evolve evaluation systems, including datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and automated pipelines that support development and launch decisions..<br>• Evaluate response quality across multiple dimensions, including relevance, completeness, freshness, factual accuracy, and usefulness to downstream agents..<br>• Investigate quality regressions and metric anomalies, uncover root causes, and identify the improvements with the greatest potential impact..<br>• Help prioritize the product and engineering roadmap, making quality trade-offs explicit and assessing whether changes deliver meaningful improvements for users..</p> <p><strong><u>We expect you to have:</u></strong></p> <p>• Substantial hands-on experience designing and building evaluation or quality measurement systems for complex technology products, such as search, AI agents, voice technologies, autonomous driving, recommendation systems, advertising, or other similar complex systems..<br>• A track record of owning ambiguous problems from initial framing through implementation, diagnosis, and measurable product improvement..<br>• Strong Python skills and an engineering mindset: you can turn analytical ideas into reliable, maintainable pipelines and tools..<br>• A solid foundation in mathematical statistics and practical experience with experimental design, sampling, uncertainty, and measurement bias..<br>• Strong analytical judgment: you understand what a metric captures, what it misses, and whether an observed improvement matters to users..<br>• The ability to reason across user needs, product behavior, and technical systems, and to translate that understanding into actionable evaluations..<br>• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and product decisions..<br>• The independence to make progress in a fast-moving environment where requirements, methods, and definitions of success are still evolving.</p> </li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation</li> <li>Career growth and learning opportunities</li> <li>Flexibility and ownership</li> <li>Collaborative and innovative culture</li> <li>Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects</li> <li>International environment and talented teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's it like to work at Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</p> <p>Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. </p> <p>If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer, Liquidity Management (C#/.NET)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.</span></p></div><p>The mission, should you choose to accept it, is to pioneer and scale Ripple Treasury's liquidity platform into the future. If you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast-paced, collaborative, and iterative environment this might be the right role for you!</p> <p>We are seeking an innovative and forward-thinking <strong>Staff Software Developer</strong> passionate about building a world-class platform through a world-class team. Creating technical software excellence and spearheading application development in design, implementation, and maintenance to make magic happen.</p> <h1>About the Liquidity Management Team</h1> <p>The Liquidity Management team is at the forefront of a major modernization initiative, reimagining how enterprise treasury teams manage liquidity across a global landscape.</p> <p>We're not just title: Talent Lead
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role ElevenLabs has grown to over 1,000 in three years, and the rate of growth is not slowing down. As Talent Lead, you will be in charge of one of the most visible and impactful functions in the company: hundreds of hires a quarter across Research, Engineering, GTM and Operations, in one of the most competitive talent markets in history. You’ll move Talent from a high-volume recruiting engine to a strategic partner that tells leaders what is achievable, and you’ll rebuild how we hire using the same AI products we make. You'll run the entire Talent team (currently 20 - 30 recruiters, sourcers, and talent operations) across verticals, setting the strategy, building the systems, and staying hands-on where it matters. You'll report directly to the Operations Lead and be a close partner to the People team. This isn't a pure executive role - we want someone who still loves the craft of recruiting and can model what great looks like for the team around them. The right person has done this before at scale - at a company that grew fast and hired harder. Your team will look to you not just for direction, but as someone they can genuinely learn from. This will be an opportunity to shape the direction of Talent at ElevenLab; where we go, how we get there and who we get there with. If you want to shape the future of the Talent industry by building industry-defining playbooks using the latest technology and AI solutions, whilst building an expert team - this might be your best fit yet. In this role you will: Lead the full talent function across Research, GTM, Engineering & Product, and G&A hiring - setting strategy, managing team performance, building a recruiter capacity engine, and driving outcomes across all verticals. Shape Talent Operations: ATS (Ashby) configuration, headcount tracking, hiring velocity metrics, and recruiter tooling - ensuring the function runs with precision and minimal friction. Identify innovative ways of approaching Talent: design the next-gen Talent org structure, envision how Talent processes can be agentified and work with the team to build ElevenLabs products throughout. Act as a strategic partner to department heads and hiring managers, bringing market intelligence, pipeline health visibility, and honest counsel on what it takes to consistently win the best people in the market. Build and maintain a strong talent brand through thoughtful candidate experience, community engagement, building a Talent events program and creative sourcing strategies. Coach and develop a team of recruiters, establishing clear standards for quality of hire, speed, and candidate experience. Partner with functional leaders across Research, Engineering, GTM, and Operations - acting as a trusted advisor who can challenge, align, and mobilize leaders around talent priorities and workforce strategy. We’re moving quickly on this search. Applications close on 13 November 2026, and we’ll start reviewing right away, so we’d encourage you to apply early. Requirements Proven track record leading large TA functions at high-growth companies, with direct experience filling hundreds of roles per year across multiple functions and geographies. Hands-on recruiting instincts - comfortable being in the weeds on critical searches, not just managing from a distance. Strong people leader who builds, develops, and retains recruiting talent. Sharp on process: able to design and iterate on systems, tooling, and workflows that make a team of 20–30 perform at a high level with AI. Close collaborator with People, Finance, and business leaders - comfortable operating at the intersection of headcount planning, compensation, and hiring strategy. Held a high bar for quality of hire while hitting aggressive volume, with the metrics to show it. Advised founders and executive suite on workforce planning, and changed a plan with your judgment. Worked with Finance, People and RevOps on headcount planning, capacity modelling, compensation and offer strategy. Has recruited across the Americas, EMEA and APAC and understands the differences between markets. Location This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere, with the ability to operate from New York or London strongly preferred. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. Remote within the UK, or from our offices in London or Cambridge if you prefer. The opportunity CircuitHub is trying to solve a difficult problem: why can software engineers iterate almost instantly while hardware engineers can still wait weeks or months to manufacture a new design? The company was founded by engineers who had experienced that frustration first-hand. What began as software to make ordering electronics easier has evolved into a much more ambitious manufacturing platform, combining software, robotics and automation to redesign the production process itself. Today CircuitHub operates an automated electronics manufacturing platform serving hardware businesses across areas including robotics, autonomous systems and other advanced technology applications. Its proprietary Grid system is a factory-scale robotic assembly platform designed for rapid, high-mix electronics production. The business is now scaling quickly. CircuitHub has raised $45 million to expand manufacturing capacity in both the US and Europe, building on operations in Massachusetts and its growing UK presence. Cambridge is becoming an increasingly important hub alongside London and the company's distributed team. That growth creates a corresponding need to strengthen the operating infrastructure behind the company. Finance is one of the areas where CircuitHub has deliberately remained lean for longer than it probably should have. Context: where finance is today The finance team is led by a Finance Director and Management Accountant, both experienced, qualified accountants. This role brings dedicated financial accounting and technical reporting capability into the team, taking ownership of the books, the audit and the technical questions that come with a growing international group. CircuitHub uses NetSuite to operate its inter-company financial model across the UK and US. A significant amount of day-to-day UK finance activity is outsourced, while the internal team takes greater ownership of the larger US operation, group reporting and consolidation. This role will be the main point of contact for the outsourced firm, reviewing their work and making sure it meets the standard the group needs, while also working across the US side and the wider mechanics of an international business. Just as importantly, CircuitHub is thinking carefully about what the next generation of finance roles should look like. AI and automation are already being deployed across the company, including in areas where repetitive finance work can be made considerably more efficient. That makes strong technical accountants even more important. CircuitHub needs people who understand the numbers well enough to judge whether automated output is right, and who can use technology to improve how finance works without weakening control. That combination of technical accounting, real ownership and a technology-enabled way of working is a central part of the opportunity. The mandate The Group Financial Accountant will take ownership of CircuitHub’s financial accounting across the UK and US. That means understanding how the books are put together, running a reliable close and being the person the Finance Director, the auditors and the outsourced accounting firm rely on for accurate, well-supported numbers. Alongside the core accounts, the role will lead on technical accounting as the business scales. CircuitHub is investing heavily in manufacturing capacity and moving towards more flexible commercial models, which raises questions around revenue recognition, capitalisation and intercompany that need a clear owner. The candidate must be willing to get their hands dirty to get a full appreciation of the sales cycle & work with the Finance Director to improve our systems and controls to improve our collection cycle, reducing DSO & further automation for our credit offering. The candidate should have a good technical understanding in accounting that can lead to developing financial operations without complicating or delaying the reporting process. Developing our systems to improve the speed and efficiency of areas such as revenue recognition, R&D capitalisation & the consolidation process. What you will work on The precise balance will evolve with the candidate, but the remit is expected to include: Financial accounting and close. Own month-end, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations, with a clear understanding of how the accounts fit together. Audit and statutory reporting. Act as the first point of contact for the auditors, manage their requests and prepare supporting schedules under UK GAAP and IFRS. Technical accounting. Lead projects such as IFRS 15 revenue recognition, the capitalisation policy and the treatment of intercompany transactions as the business and its commercial models develop. Group reporting. Support reporting across the UK and US entities, including intercompany reconciliations, and contribute to group consolidation in NetSuite where experience allows. Outsourced provider management. Manage the relationship with the UK outsourced accounting firm, reviewing their output and holding it to the standard the group needs. NetSuite and finance systems. Work directly in NetSuite and across the different systems and platforms that feed into it. Understand how data moves through the business rather than treating the accounting system in isolation. AI and automation. Review and take ownership of automated and AI-generated finance output, making sure it is accurate and properly controlled, and help identify where further automation makes sense. What success looks like The first objective is to be a safe pair of hands. That means solving outstanding technical issues, taking ownership of monthly & quarterly close, a well-run audit and numbers the Finance Director and the team can trust without needing to revisit them. From there, success means taking ownership of the technical agenda: a clear approach to revenue recognition as commercial models change, a robust capitalisation policy as CircuitHub invests in capacity, and clean intercompany accounting across the UK and US. Over time, the finance team should have the capacity to report more frequently, stronger oversight of outsourced work and less technical accounting sitting with the Finance Director simply because nobody else can own it. Processes should improve as well as move faster. Automation should remove low-value work without weakening financial control. This is a role to build into over time. The scope will grow with the finance function and with the contribution the individual makes to it. As the business scales, the role is expected to grow into Group Financial Controller. The person we are looking for CircuitHub is looking for a qualified or near-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with strong technical foundations. The specific qualification matters less than acumen, drive and personal qualities. You are likely to have trained in practice, whether at a Big 4 or a top 20 firm, and be looking for your first move into an operating business. Alternatively, you may already be working in industry, in which case you will be qualified or close to qualifying. The strongest signals are: Relevant exposure. Experience getting the most out of NetSuite, working in a finance team to produce accounting information & ability to work autonomously and conscientiously to meet deadlines. Technical grounding. Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS and a clear understanding of how a set of accounts is put together. Technology fluency. You are comfortable working across systems and genuinely interested in how AI is changing finance. You see automation as a tool, not a substitute for judgement. Practical curiosity. When something does not reconcile or a process feels unnecessarily difficult, your instinct is to understand why. Commitment to building. You are motivated by breadth and ownership, and you want to build something over time in a growing business. Interest in the business. CircuitHub sits at the intersection of software, robotics and physical manufacturing. You do not need an electronics background, but an interest in technology and how real products are built will make the environment much more compelling. Why CircuitHub This is a chance to join a profitable, fast-growing robotics and manufacturing business at a pivotal stage of scale, in a role with genuine technical ownership. You will work closely with experienced qualified accountants and gain a breadth of exposure that is rare this early in an industry career: revenue recognition, capitalisation, intercompany, audit and reporting across a UK and US group. You will also build for where finance is going next. CircuitHub is already using AI, automation and connected systems across the business, creating the opportunity to combine strong technical accounting with skills in systems, data and automation. For someone with the capability and drive, there is real scope to grow as CircuitHub scales and the finance function builds out around it. Pay £75k–£85k, depending on experience, plus equity. title: Senior Influencer Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h3><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h3> <p>The Airbnb Communications team drives earned visibility and cultural relevance for the brand, delivering campaigns that support direct traffic, brand love and positive conversation. Our influencer function sits at the intersection of culture, content and community — leading social-first campaigns that inspire travel on Airbnb and strengthen its long-term reputation.</p> <h3><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for a Senior Influencer Manager to lead Airbnb's influencer programme in the<strong><em> </em></strong>UK, localising regional priorities and delivering campaigns that connect the brand to culturally relevant conversations.</p> <p>The role covers our full influencer remit: earned and organic creator partnerships, and influencer work running through paid media. You'll own campaigns end to end — creator sourcing, briefing, contracting, measurement and reporting — and help position influencers as both a commercial lever and a long-term driver of brand health, while collaborating with agency partners.</p> <p>Sitting in the UK Communications team, you'll build influencer into campaign narratives from inception, and partner with Brand Marketing and Paid Media so creator content is designed for amplification from the outset, with usage rights, whitelisting and dark posting permissions secured up front.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role for someone who knows how to turn brand objectives into content that is authentic, thumb-stopping and earns attention rather than interrupting it.</p> <h3><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own and scale Airbnb's influencer programme in the UK against local, regional and global priorities — timelines, creative execution and performance</li> <li>Deliver across earned, organic and paid influencer work, partnering with the regional Influencer Lead and the UK Brand Marketing and Paid Media teams on creator selection, briefing for amplification, permissions and asset delivery</li> <li>Build influencer into the core campaign narrative and press strategy from inception, with the UK Communications team</li> <li>Identify, vet and build relationships with creators across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — emerging talent through to established partners — with inclusive, culturally relevant casting</li> <li>Write clear, strategic briefs covering objectives, key messages and content guidelines, and lead onboarding and content reviews against brand standards</li> <li>Partner with legal and agency teams on contracts: deliverables, usage rights, paid media, exclusivity and payment</li> <li>Stay plugged into culture, consumer and media trends — particularly Gen Z — bringing forward creator ideas and campaign hooks, and moving fast on reactive opportunities</li> <li>Manage logistics for influencer stays and experiences, including vetting, Host coordination and credit approvals</li> <li>Track performance across commercial and brand health metrics using CreatorIQ,Sprinklr and Airtable, optimising with the agency and reporting to the regional team</li> <li>Align plans with local Marketing, Partnerships, Affiliate and Growth teams and the global influencer team to avoid duplicated effort</li> <li>Lead day-to-day communication and program operations with our respective UK Influencer agency partners </li> <li>Identify opportunities with key opinion formers — policy, cultural and news influencers, and third-party validators — for reputation campaigns</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years in communications, influencer marketing, talent partnerships or social-first content strategy</li> <li>Deep knowledge of the UK creator landscape and strong instincts on what resonates and why, across a diverse audience</li> <li>A communications mindset: a track record of building creator partnerships into integrated campaigns, connected to the earned, social and reputation storytelling around them</li> <li>End-to-end campaign experience across organic and paid environments — sourcing, briefing for amplification, dark posting, usage rights, contracting and performance analysis</li> <li>Confident negotiating with creators and managing external agencies and stakeholders across legal, marketing and comms</li> <li>Strong writing, particularly briefs and content feedback</li> <li>Familiarity with influencer tools (CreatorIQ, Sprinklr or similar tooling platforms) and reporting that quantifies brand health and sentiment, not just reach and engagement</li> <li>Able to run multiple campaigns and creators at once with high attention to detail</li> <li>Belief in influencer as a driver of long-term brand equity, not just short-term performance</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£72,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£90,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (Life Sciences practice)
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.crai.com/">Charles River Associates</a></strong> is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. </p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>CRA’s <strong><a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2Findustries%2Flife-sciences%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cakimball%40crai.com%7Cea67c91398754dca094608ded2ba7e0c%7C4a156c19bc9441acaacf954686490869%7C0%7C0%7C639179895609780605%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=KsJhZhqtnMhJKdJrhhCfvbIxa7MQpmtL2vIB9OXdxAk%3D&reserved=0">Life Sciences</a></strong> practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.</p> <p>Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.</p> <p>To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;</li> <li>Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;</li> <li>Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;</li> <li>Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;</li> <li>Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;</li> <li>Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;</li> <li>3-6 years previous consulting experience;</li> <li>Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;</li> <li>Proven staff and project management skills;</li> <li>Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;</li> <li>Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);</li> <li>Occasional travel required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>To Apply</strong></p> <p>To be considered for this position, we require the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Resume</strong> – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Cover letter</strong> – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Career Growth and Benefits </strong></p> <ul> <li>CRA’s robust <strong><a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/talent-development/">skills development programs</a></strong>, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.</li> <li>We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, <a href="https://www.crai.com/benefits/"><strong>wellness programmin</strong>g</a> to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house <strong><a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/immigration-global-mobility/">immigration support</a></strong> for foreign nationals and international business travelers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <p><strong>Responsible AI Use in Recruiting</strong></p> <p>We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/ai-recruiting/">on our website</a>.  </p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). Intermediate skills in Outlook, PowerPoint, and Word;</li> <li>Experience working with an ATS (Greenhouse) desirable;</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of productivity, able to advance tasks with diplomacy and tact, and a willingness to take ownership of work;</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, able to find creative solutions without getting flustered, and willing to dig for an answer;</li> <li>Exceptional attention to detail, focused ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks with tight turnarounds and multiple time zones;</li> <li>Good judgment,<strong> </strong>aware of confidentiality expectations, and discretion with sensitive information.</li> </ul> <p><strong>To Apply</strong></p> <p>To be considered for this position, please submit:</p> <p></p> <ul> <li><strong>CV/Resume</strong> – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Cover letter</strong> – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.</li> </ul> <p></p> <h4>Work Location Flexibility</h4> <p>Charles River Associates creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently ask that individuals spend 3 to 4 days a week on average working in the office (which may include traveling to another Charles River Associates office or to a client's location), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <h4>Our Commitment to Diversity</h4> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer (Equality Act 2010). As part of our focus on equity and inclusion, we work to ensure a fair and consistent hiring process. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to an inclusive work environment.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><em>CRA offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility requirements, which may include: medical, dental, and vision insurance; pension scheme with employer match; life and disability insurance; paid time off (holiday, sick leave, paid holidays); paid parental leave; wellness programs and employee assistance resources; and commuter benefits.</em></span></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Principal (European Competition practice)
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provide clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns.</p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>CRA's European Competition Practice specialises in providing economic advice on matters of competition policy and regulation. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. We offer assistance on the estimation of effects and damages in cartel cases, international arbitration and intellectual property disputes.</p> <p><em>For more information on the Antitrust and Competition Economics practice in Europe visit <span style="text-decoration: underline;">http://ecp.crai.com</span>.</em></p> <p>Associate Principals have the unique opportunity to learn from, and work alongside, some of the most respected scholars, specialists, and industry experts in the world.  We tailor our analyses to the facts of each case, employing tools such as merger simulation, upward pricing pressure analysis, econometrics, bargaining theory, or game theory as needed. Whether before a court or a regulatory agency, CRA consultants set a high standard for the clear communication of sophisticated economic analysis in complex cases. You will have access to internal training programs focused on creative problem solving, communications, and leading and managing colleagues, teams and cases.  In addition, our firm offers extracurricular activities where you can take additional leadership roles in recruiting, training, and volunteer activities in the local community.</p> <p>A typical Associate Principal would:</p> <ul> <li>Work closely with leading academics and consulting with attorneys and other clients in industry and government on a wide variety of finance, strategy and economics issues;</li> <li>Conduct research in a supportive, team-oriented environment;</li> <li>Act as a primary point of contact for clients and assist in the development and presentation of client deliverables including expert reports summarizing our opinions, conclusions, and recommendations and third party financial, market and industry data;</li> <li>Independently conceptualize and identify issues, design complex economic and financial models to analyze economic and financial data;</li> <li>Oversee analysis in statistical analysis programs (such as Stata, SAS, R or Python);</li> <li>Manage the research process, and supervising, training and mentoring junior analysts;</li> <li>Ensure the integrity and accuracy of analyses and opinions;</li> <li>Work with those testifying in judicial proceedings to provide economic analyses of mergers and other competition matters before the major competition authorities of the world;</li> <li>Assist with recruiting and training of new colleagues.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong achievement in a graduate degree program (Masters or PhD) with focused study in economics or a related discipline;</li> <li>Extensive and relevant experience (6-9 years), economics/antitrust consulting experience preferred;</li> <li>Demonstrated understanding of economic concepts, competition/regulatory authorities and quantitative and qualitative analysis methods;</li> <li>Exceptional written and oral communication skills;</li> <li>Experience managing and developing teams of junior colleagues;</li> <li>Executive client presence and interaction skills.</li> </ul> <h4>To Apply</h4> <p>To be considered for this position, submit through this job posting:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Curriculum Vitae</strong> – please include current contact We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of cross-border payments, banking infrastructure and digital assets. You’ll help develop propositions that enable our clients to move money internationally through both traditional payment infrastructure and emerging digital asset and stablecoin rails. Financial control processes become increasingly automated, scalable and efficient as ClearBank grows. AI-enabled tools are successfully adopted to improve productivity, insight and operational effectiveness. Stakeholders receive accurate, timely and reliable financial information that supports decision-making and reporting obligations. The role works effectively with colleagues across Finance and the wider business to deliver high-quality outcomes. The role demonstrates excellence in both what is delivered and how it is delivered through strong collaboration, ownership, continuous improvement and leadership behaviours. Strong technical accounting knowledge, including experience interpreting and applying accounting standards. title: Field Marketing Manager
description: Why Rogo Our mission is to transform global finance by empowering professionals at the world's top investment banks, private equity funds, and investment firms with AI that delivers unparalleled speed, accuracy, and insight. We're not just improving financial workflows; we're redefining them. This is a unique opportunity to join a generational company driving transformation in one of the most important industries in the world. With a rapidly growing, global client base, proven product-market fit, and backing from world-class investors, we are scaling quickly and defining a new category of enterprise AI. Our team is sharp, motivated, and deeply committed to Rogo’s mission. We take ownership of complex problems and stay relentlessly focused on our users. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, demand excellence, and want to help build the future of finance, we invite you to join us. The Role: Rogo is looking for a dynamic and strategic Field Marketing Manager to help maximize our brand reach and shape Rogo’s field strategy at a time of rapid growth and innovation. This person will both architect and execute high-impact, high-touch events that drive awareness, and strengthen our presence across the finance industry in key markets – both domestically and abroad. Successful events that we run will showcase our bench of senior talent and have a bespoke, sophisticated execution to engage some of the most discerning audiences in the world. What You’ll Do: Implement an event strategy that is anchored in field events (e.g. conferences, trade shows, panels, roundtables, fireside chats, networking events, VIP experiences, dinners, happy hours, partner events, brand activations, product launch activations and employer branding events) Implement a smaller-scale virtual event strategy to augment our field event strategy (webinars, virtual activations and experiences) Manage event logistics, including vendor sourcing, budgeting, attendee management, and on-site execution Implement formulaic onsite lead capture and post-event follow up sequences to maximize ROI and ensure consistency Manage an ongoing event budget Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, product and senior stakeholders to support major initiatives Own and report outcomes around both individual events and the broader field marketing roadmap Maintain brand consistency (appearance, tone, voice and vibe) across events What You’ll Need: 5+ years of field marketing or event marketing experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, Institutional finance, FinTech or AI Proven track record of planning and executing both in-person and virtual events that drive pipeline and brand awareness Strong project management and organizational skills — demonstrated ability to manage multiple, complex programs simultaneously Ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments and adapt in ambiguous situations The ability to code-switch between reactive mode of quickly placing an executive in a an existing event in a few days and proactive mode by conceiving and executing a Rogo-hosted event end-to-end over months Who You Are You thrive in fast-paced environments. You are high-intensity and care a lot about what you do, and you're ecstatic to work at a startup. You are ambitious. You have fun solving problems that others think are impossible. You are curious. You find joy in learning about AI, technology, and finance. You are an owner. You are autonomous, self-directed, and comfortable working with ambiguity. You are collaborative, organized, thoughtful, and kind . Why Join Rogo? Up and to the right: Rogo has strong product adoption with the world's leading financial institutions, and we are still early. The upside is enormous. Extraordinary team: we take talent density seriously. You'll do the best work of your career alongside some of the sharpest people in AI and finance. A one-of-one problem: bringing AI to the core of how Wall Street works is one of the most ambitious, technically demanding, and consequential problems today. There is nowhere else you can work on it at this scale. Real ownership : You'll own real surface area and watch the world's most sophisticated users rely on your work. Always at the frontier: we work at the edge of what the best models can do and turn it into products people trust. If you're obsessed with AI, this is where it's happening. title: Channel Partnerships Lead
description: Want to join a team of passionate people who want to build a future where no one dies from skin cancer? 👋 About us We're an AI Health Tech company in the UK and Europe, leading from the front in the AI Diagnostics space. Our AI Platform, DERM, is the UK’s and Europe’s first autonomous Class III AI as a medical device, certified to the same safety standard as a pacemaker. Independently proven to perform at least as well as a face-to-face dermatologist assessment, our technology is giving millions of people access to a fast and accurate way to detect skin cancer, saving significant time and costs for global healthcare systems and improving outcomes for patients. DERM has been an integrated part of NHS dermatology pathways for over six years and is already in use in 25 NHS Trusts, and trusted by private health providers including Bupa and Vitality. It has assessed over 300,000 patients and found more than 25,000 cancers, validated by histopathology, the diagnostic gold standard. We are fast growing, raised £15M in series B funding in 2025, and are scaling across Europe - with regulatory approvals underway in other regions. In June 2026, we launched DERM Zero, the world' s first Class III regulated medical device technology to deliver autonomous clinical grade skin cancer assessments from a smartphone, changing the way that people can access clinically validated skin cancer checks. If working for one of Time Magazine World’s Top Health Tech Companies appeals then we’d like to hear from you. We are hiring across science, technology, product, operations and commercial. Brief overview We’re looking for a Channel Partnerships Lead to build a brand-new revenue channel: distributing DERM through globally scaled third-party technology platforms such as teleconsultation services, digital health marketplaces and primary-care tech providers. You’ll own every partnership end to end, from identifying and qualifying partners through business case, negotiation and signed agreement, to live launch and ongoing growth. You’ll run a methodical, stage-gated process and work closely with our Clinical, Regulatory, Legal, Data Protection, Product and Engineering teams to make every partnership safe, compliant and technically deliverable. Reporting to the Head of Commercial International, you’ll collaborate tightly and transparently with our direct sales teams across European markets. This is a chance to shape how DERM reaches millions more patients, and to build a repeatable revenue line from the ground up. Responsibilities Identify and prioritise prospective platform partners across target markets, building and maintaining a partnership pipeline. Own the end-to-end partnership process: outreach, business case, commercial negotiation, MOU and definitive agreement, through to launch. Design partnership and pricing models (e.g. embedded, referral, API/licence) suited to each partner’s product and workflow. Work cross-functionally with Clinical, Regulatory, Legal, Data Protection, Product, Marketing, Finance and Engineering to make partnerships safe, compliant, sustainable and technically deliverable. Define and track success metrics for each partnership (e.g. attach rate, volume, revenue) and manage the commercial relationship post-launch. Collaborate tightly and transparently with the direct sales team across markets to avoid channel conflict. Represent Skin Analytics at industry events and partner forums to build our profile with health tech platforms. Required Experience A proven track record of independently sourcing, negotiating and closing complex commercial partnerships with deep technical and operational integrations, ideally in digital health or another regulated industry. Experience working within the regulatory, clinical and data protection constraints of medical device or health-data partnerships. Strong commercial and analytical judgement: you can build a robust business case and pricing model, and win over senior stakeholders. The technical acumen to scope integrations (APIs, data flows, workflows) with product and engineering teams, internally and at partners. Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills across European markets. Nice to have (but we can teach you) An established network in the telehealth and medtech industry. Additional European language skills. Benefits 💰 Competitive salary 📈 Share options package - all our employees have ownership in the company 🏥 Private healthcare 💸 Company pension incl. salary sacrifice options 🌴 25 days annual leave + 5 day company shutdown in August + bank holidays 👪 Enhanced parental leave - includes adoption & foster 🐣 Yellownest Salary Sacrifice Nursery Scheme - save with workplace nursery scheme 🚲 Bike to work scheme 💻 Training budget 🤝 Weekly catch-ups, monthly meetings to talk about you, your ambitions and work on your development 🎊 Lots of fun social activities! Our Values 🌱 Building a Strong Foundation 🎓 Always Learning 🏅 Lead from the Front 💪 Tough and Resilient The Real Stuff Skin Analytics embraces and is committed to diversity and equal opportunities. We are dedicated to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. If you need any adjustments during our hiring process, you can indicate that at the next step. Exceptional collaboration skills to strategically partner with product, engineering, and research to align design outcomes with core business and user objectives. Expertise in systems thinking, sophisticated interaction design, and establishing robust, data-connected workflows. Comfortable using emerging AI tools and rapidly testing ideas with Product and Engineering. Familiarity with or a strong interest in Object-Oriented UX (OOUX), advanced information architecture, and data modeling principles. Ability to define, track, and analyze success metrics to measure the tangible impact and effectiveness of design solutions.
